name: ARM_MUL
ARM_LDRH_reg
ARM_LDRSB_reg
semantics:
let rn = (op >> 16) & 0xF
let rd = (op >> 12) & 0xF
let p = ((op >> 24) & 1) != 0
let u = ((op >> 23) & 1) != 0
let w = ((op >> 21) & 1) != 0
let off = rr(op & 0xF)
let base = rr(rn)
let addr = if u then (base + off) & MASK32 else (base - off) & MASK32
let ea = if p then addr else base
let v = sext(rd8(ea), 8) & MASK32
if (not p or w) and rn != rd {
  wr(rn, addr)
}
wr(rd, v)
